title: Ole Rømer’s temperature correction of pendulum clock rates
lineage: Paraphrased notes from the inspected source, not a reproduction.

passages.locator: pp. 523–524, Measuring the temperature and notes 10–12
passages.note: The history cites Rømer’s 1702 Adversaria and reproduces Fahrenheit’s 1729 letter recalling a 1708 visit to Rømer’s thermometers. The eyewitness letter dates after the visit.
